scope: Credential-free probes on the same prepared image as the successful native subscription task

process_probe.scanner_positive_control: A subprocess with the canary in its environment, arguments and open file produced at least three matches; no captured values were printed
process_probe.earlier_failed_attempt: Stopped on EAGAIN from a nonblocking kernel read. VM cleanup passed. The scanner now counts that read as unavailable; only this probe was repeated.

limitations: Synthetic host canary, not disclosure or collection of real provider tokens
Finite process snapshot and regular-file handles up to 64 KiB; no kernel-exploit or arbitrary memory proof
Gateway control is an actual 403 response, not a successful public download; public research success is covered by the separate real subscription task
Direct fallback observation targets the reachable host-namespace TCP canary; does not enumerate every possible destination
Earlier wire-DNS, mixed/CNAME and HTTPS redirect component results remain supporting evidence, not newly repeated whole-worker trials
Tests ran before START and changed no assignment consent or provider budget
